title: Nestle, Tata Consumer lead an FMCG rush as Sensex adds 1,225 points; Nifty ends at 23,811
short: FMCG rush lifts Sensex 1,225 pts, Nifty to 23,811
dek: Consumer stocks took the baton from Reliance. The Nifty rose 1.58% for a fourth straight gain, while SBI slipped despite a 14% jump in profit.
card: Nifty +370.05 at 23,810.85, Sensex +1,225.07 at 76,917.85. Nifty FMCG +3.65%, Marico +10%; SBI −1.70% and Power Grid −3.04%.
